data.name: Fey
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Fey was a goddess of the forest and nature. Her name derives from the Greek word for 'mist' or 'fog', symbolizing the mystery and enchantment of the natural world. In Christianity, Fey is sometimes associated with the Virgin Mary, representing the hidden wisdom and grace within.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the divine mystery hidden within nature and ourselves.
data.numerology_meaning: A nurturing and caring personality, Fey is known for their devotion and compassion. They have a strong intuition and a deep connection to nature.
